card.name: RT inside NNRTI and similar abbreviations
card.fires_on: The letters "RT" when they are the middle of an abbreviation, mostly NNRTI (non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor) in HIV drug interaction text. Also in WBRT and ATV+RTV.

modes.label: NNRTI abbreviation
modes.description: RT after NN in NNRTI or NNRTIs, in HIV drug interaction text.

modes.label: Other RT abbreviations
modes.description: RT ending or inside other abbreviations such as WBRT (radiation therapy), RTV (ritonavir) or DEFINITY RT.
modes.example: 49 percent of patients who received WB<<RT>> experienced a decline in learning and memory function
